facts.anchor: It had been a terrible night. A terrible string of nights.
facts.fact: Catherine 连续过了好几个糟糕的夜晚，婴儿 Elisabeth 整夜吃奶，两人都没睡。

facts.anchor: Catherine had just turned twenty but she didn’t have time to celebrate.
facts.fact: Catherine 刚满二十岁，没有时间庆祝。

facts.anchor: she told Catherine to call the local priest to perform an exorcism.
facts.fact: 母亲 Patricia 在一次散步中听到 Elisabeth 尖叫后，让 Catherine 去请当地神父来做驱魔。

facts.anchor: he is the man who raised you. He’s your dad. But he’s not—
facts.fact: Catherine 对女儿说：Seb 是把她养大的人、是她的爸爸，但不是（她的生父）。

facts.anchor: She ran to the stroller, but Elisabeth wasn’t there. She wasn’t there.
facts.fact: Catherine 冲回婴儿车，发现 Elisabeth 不在车里。

facts.anchor: beside her stroller, a man she didn’t know, and he was holding a baby.
facts.fact: Catherine 在婴儿车旁看见一个她不认识的男人，他正抱着一个婴儿。

facts.anchor: He proposed four months after they met and she said yes
facts.fact: Seb 在两人相识四个月后求婚，Catherine 答应了。

facts.anchor: With that, her daughter leaves, just as Catherine had predicted.
facts.fact: 说完这些，女儿 Elise 起身离开，正如 Catherine 预料的那样。
